name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began in his grandfather's garage, where he spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the fundamentals of mechanics. This hands-on experience fueled his passion and led him to pursue a degree in Motorsport Engineering. After graduating, he secured an apprenticeship with a local rally team, where he honed his fabrication skills and gained valuable experience in a fast-paced environment. 

Now at EKS JC, Rhys is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly adapt to changing circumstances. He approaches every task with a positive attitude and a willingness to learn, making him a valuable asset to the team. His fast-worker trait means he's usually ahead of schedule, allowing for additional quality checks and improvements.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a wiry build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Can often be found humming quietly while working.
Insists on cleaning his workspace thoroughly at the end of each day.
